name: Iceboat

items.name: Ice Traverser
items.text: Ice is not difficult terrain for iceboats. However, they're unable to travel over land unless it's completely covered in ice.

items.name: Steel Keel
items.text: Iceboats have steel blades affixed to their keels and outriggers that enable them to travel over ice at tremendous speed.

text: In addition to sailing across open water, this vessel can also travel at high speeds over frozen rivers, lakes, oceans, and fjords.
